• Skinny: fitted closely from waist to ankle for a sleek look
• Straight: goes down fairly straight through the leg, easy and versatile
• Bootcut: fitted through the thigh with a slight flare at the bottom
• Flare: fitted up top with a wider flare from the knee down
• Wide leg: roomy through the leg for a relaxed, fashion-forward feel
• Boyfriend: looser, more casual fit with a laid-back look
• Barrel leg: relaxed with a curved leg shape for a more modern silhouette
• Crops: shorter length that hits above the ankle
• Shorts: same denim feel in a short style
